question: Does dual-input Givens Mirror SwiGLU exhibit delayed generalization beyond memorization, and is its lag / learning curve better than equal-parameter gain or pair-specific Mirror on four jointly learned modular rules?
prior_evidence: DMFFN-001 compositional SwiGLU only aligned synthetic teacher
DMFFN-003 independent natural digits do not show unseen-pair transfer
AlQuabeh et al. arXiv:2505.15624 embedding coupling
scope: Synthetic grokking mechanism only. The independent variable is Mirror parameterization; raw one-hot embeddings are learned in first SwiGLU matrices. Not a Transformer or natural language result.

data.world_definition: independent random split of same fixed modular universe
data.target: four Cartesian tasks y_ij=(a_i*a+b_j*b) mod31 with a_i,b_j in {1,2}

model.Mirror: two gate codes and two up codes for disjoint-plane Givens; 4 pair functions
model.alternative: pair-specific Givens with 8 planes, equal parameter count

training.control_no_decay: Mirror identical architecture and seed, weight_decay 0

primary.delayed_generalization: train>=0.99 and test<=0.30 at train_onset, then test>=0.50 at least 1000 updates after train_onset
primary.strong_grokking: train>=0.99 and test<=0.30 at train_onset, test>=0.90 at least 1000 updates later
primary.censor: if threshold not reached by 8000 mark missing, never infer eventual passage
primary.unit: random data split world, 2 initialization seeds nested
primary.gates: no hypothesized pass until fresh evaluation; judge paired 3-world effects and expose all negative cases

calibration.note: selected hypothesis/protocol without checking fresh worlds; observed Mirror+native curves on one development split

controls: native gain codes equal counted parameters
pair-specific code angles equal counted parameters
boundaries: test-input holdout is not unseen composition: all four (i,j) tasks supervised
three data splits share same p and rule universe
no natural digits / target teacher evidence
no claim Mirror-specific scaling, GPU or actual Transformer speed
strict grokking vs gradual test recovery must be distinguished
repository_rule: research branch only; preserve DMFFN-001 and DMFFN-003 historical records, main and canonical registry
